opening: What started as a hobby became a bit of an addiction, and an outlet I can’t imagine my weeks without now.

milestones.title: Walking into Church Street.
paragraphs: I started boxing in January 2024 at Church Street Boxing Gym in Chelsea. Initially, I just wanted to lose weight. To put it simply, I’d been enjoying New York’s nightlife and food scene way too much and had lost sight of being fit.
I was also bored of lifting, not that I was ever super elite at it, and wanted to explore an interest I’d always had in combat sports. So I gave boxing a shot.

milestones.title: Starting to spar.
paragraphs: I started sparring toward the end of 2024. It hurt at first, and I still had a long way to go. It was the start of a whole new part of the learning process.

milestones.title: Taking it more seriously.
paragraphs: In 2025, I started taking the sport more seriously. What began as a hobby was becoming a much bigger part of my life.
Here’s a sparring clip from 2025, one of the earlier chapters in that progression.

milestones.title: Hundreds of rounds. Still learning.
paragraphs: By 2026, I’d accumulated hundreds of rounds of sparring and learning. I still have so much more to learn and room to grow.
Boxing has become an outlet I can’t imagine my weeks without. Here are a few more moments from that journey: sparring and mitt-work clips, both from 2026.

milestones.title: An amateur fight. Then, keep growing.
paragraphs: I now have a clear goal: to have an amateur fight in 2027. Hopefully, that lays the foundation for a few more fights and for picking up more martial arts as I grow older.
I still have a long way to go. That’s part of why I want to keep a record of it here.
